title: Fluent adding and subtracting within 10
keyIdea: Fluent within 10 means you know every addition and subtraction fact with numbers 0–10 straight away — ten-frame pictures, make-10 bridges, and related take-aways — without recounting every counter.
familyTip: Flash a ten-frame with 8 filled and ask how many empty. Then say '7 + 3' and wait for a snap '10'. Follow with 'so 10 take away 3?'.

visual.caption: Within-10 fluency idea or mix-up? Drag each clue, or tap it then a box.

items: fluent within 10 means only make-10 pairs

lab.caption: Flagship lab: ten-frame fill, make-10 bridge, related take-away, snap recall, near-10 facts, catch make-10-only myth.

kid: Fluent within 10 means you know the answer straight away for adds and take-aways with numbers from 0 to 10.
A ten-frame shows how many are filled and how many are empty. Make 10: 8 needs 2 more.
If 6 + 4 = 10, then 10 − 4 = 6. The same three numbers make a related fact.
Facts within 10 are not only pairs that make 10. 5 + 3 = 8 counts too.
adult: CCSS 1.OA.6: fluently add and subtract within 10. NC Y1/Y2: related number bonds and facts within 10. Distinct from within-5 fluency (flagsum5) and from partners that make exactly 10 on a ten-frame (flagnbonds).

Words: ten-frame, make-10 bridge, related fact, fluent, within 10. Common mistakes: sticking digits (7+3 as 73); treating within 10 as only make-10 pairs; recounting every counter instead of snapping the fact.
In the lab your child fills 8 on a ten-frame, bridges 8+2 through 10, uses 10−4=6, snaps 7+3, and spots the make-10-only mix-up.
